about_the_game:
CELESTIA AND THE CELESTIAL TOWER

Celestia was once a colorful and peaceful village where Sunny, a young and fearless adventurer lived, alongside Dante, her magical pet.

One day, while Sunny was away on an expedition, the evil Purrphett and his minions attacked the village and captured all the inhabitants’ pets, retreating to the Celestial Tower, a sanctuary once protected by the Guardians of Celestia.

Upon her return, Sunny found her village desolate and its people frozen in time.

With her brave companion Dante, the two set off toward the Celestial Tower, determined to defeat Purrphett and lift the curse that had befallen Celestia.

EXPLORATION AND PUZZLES

Play as Sunny and her pets as you climb the floors of the Celestial Tower.

Solve elemental puzzles, find hidden treasures, and discover secret locations!

But beware... Purrphett’s minions are hot on your trail!

TACTICAL TURN-BASED COMBAT

Engage in epic turn-based battles!

Strategically choose your units and skillfully arrange their abilities in your spell bar.

Move across the grid, charge your mana, and unleash your elemental power!

Play even when it’s not your turn: perform parries and real-time boosts at any moment!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Inter Core i5-2300 / AMD FX-4350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 460 768 MB / AMD Radeon HD 6870 1 GB
  • Storage: 15 GB available space

short_description: Embark on a journey with Sunny and her magical pets to conquer the Celestial Tower, a once peaceful domain now taken over by an enigmatic figure. Explore the dungeon, solve puzzles, and win turn-based battles with real time mechanics to lift the curse that looms over your village.

English*, French*, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal
